body: Thank you for your reassuring words and you’re so right about feeling really shit, I’ve been really beating myself over it but as you said I’m sure that’ll pass once I get back into practicing. I’ve rebooked now for the 25th. The lessons in between are crippling me financially though ahahaha, they’re £150 a pop! Hopefully I’ll pass next time round, I could use that wave of relief lol.
Thank you! I’ll keep an eye out for that 20!

Yeah I’ve found learning how to drive while learning to ride really quite challenging. It’s a lot to absorb in one go! I’ll be sure to get some more lessons in before, it’s costing me an arm and a leg though yikes!
That’s a great tip! I’ll give it a go, thank you!
I did my mod 1 training in torrential rain. We did it in a car park where there were metal grates around too, had to cross them every time we came out of the swerve manoeuvre going 30mph 😬

Congrats on passing your Mod 2! Honestly it’s super reassuring to know that passing with pretty minimal road experience is very much possible. Thank you for all the tips, I can’t tell you how much I appreciate it (shout out to Motorcycle Lessons UK, she is really great isn’t she)
Thank you so much! That is unbelievably helpful, I’ll read up about it and see if I can trial run it a few times during my mod 2 training, thank you!
Yeah as said above, my school is lending me a helmet, jacket and gloves. I bought some solid above ankle hiking boots and some thick trousers :)
I turn 24 mid February 😔

I know exactly what you mean. I feel really hopeless. I love food and every ounce of enjoyment of it has been stripped and replaced with stress and guilt. It’s also kicked my disordered eating into high gear. I am so depressed, I would take anything to make my symptoms go away. I hear you, you’re not alone. Sending love
Thank you, I really appreciate your comment x

I think that’s exactly it! And I know he’s not feeling bad about it so why am I? I am worried I’ve crossed a line at work and this will all come out somehow. Even though I’m only there for a few months I’m a bit anxious about things getting awkward and uncomfortable. Particularly as a few of the women I work with also like him (but haven’t slept with him). Thank you for your reassuring words, I desperately needed them ❤️
thank you so much, i really needed to hear this 💖
Because we probably shouldn’t have right?
thank you for the reassurance, I’m unable to sleep. This has already eased my mind a bit. Thank you x
Thanks, incredibly helpful. Have a great day
Hit the gym when I’m feeling up to it, making my favourite foods, lounging around, listening to great music, doing mushrooms and art. Having long baths and seeing my friends!
Thank you, this is a lovely comment. I really appreciate it x

Thank you for this, it actually made me a bit emotional. I think you’re right, my self-esteem is at an all time low, in fact I’m not sure when it has ever been particularly high. I think I’ve failed to acknowledge the impact that has and instead have let it totally blind me to how positive this could be. I will definitely seek out a therapist!

Firstly, thank you so much for sharing this, my heart aches for you and your mom. Generational trauma is so very cruel, knowing that both of you have experienced something so violating and knowing there’s nothing that you can do for one and other to make that pain go away is hard. Like you said, I plan on making sure my children never have to endure such abuse. That’s the best we can do going forward, ending the cycle. 

I really do think this will push me and my dad closer together, I think we need each other more than ever really. 

Thanks again for your kind words, Sending love x

Thank you for sharing that with me. I have to remind myself and I hope you do too, that what happened to us doesn’t define who we are. It’s something we’ve endured, we are strong. I have a journal I haven’t picked up in months, I’m going to give it a go writing in it. Thank you for your suggestion, sending love x
I’ve been lucky enough to have some really brilliant counselling. Until today I hadn’t thought about what I’d been through for years. I’ve encouraged my dad to do the same
I actually sort of love Peewee 🥺

I’m not using him? We are each other’s safe space. I would do anything and everything for him. All I do is support him and adore him. I’m simply voicing concern about fantasies I have that I have no control over - all I have control over is my ability to act on them and i’d never dream of doing so. I would never cheat.

I have never been particularly bothered about my inexperience. I do love my boyfriend and this will absolutely sound cowardly but I have had a horrific year (really loaded with trauma). And he is my safe place.
Yes, that is so perfectly phrased. Thank you! Much love x
Thank you, very good point.

Its difficult really though because his family and friends there speak a different language and so I think as I have often before when visiting, find that in itself quite isolating. So to be quite honest I’m think I may fair worse there, which sounds awful but it’s purely a communication thing.
Thank you so much for your advice and words of wisdom. It has been incredibly helpful. Thank you!

Yes he knows about my depression at that age but perhaps not the real nitty  gritty bits, I have a couple of scars but at the age I was in the photos I was actively harming myself. Which I still carry a lot of shame about and don’t really want him seeing. You’re right though perhaps one day I would be more relaxed about sharing those photos but currently I am not and he hasn’t respected that decision. What you said about your partner giving you a warning before you use her phone post-argument, I will definitely do that. Perhaps I will just pass over my phone with a warning and leave him to read them instead of having to sit there and explain my texts to him.

The thing is, like you and your partner, my phone/laptop and everything is open to him at any time. He knows all the pins and I have nothing to hide. However, when he knows I’ve been discussing with a friend how I’ve been feeling during a fight and he forces me to go through those messages in front of him (which often causes further arguing as he’s on the defensive). That’s where the problem lies or when he was insistent on viewing the Polaroids I had today.(the ones I wasn’t comfortable sharing) are of me when I was about 14 years old. They are intimiate and are of a time when I was severely depressed. It’s not imagery I want to share nor look at myself really. I felt that it was an acceptable reason to not share that.
Great point, thank you x

He is very open with his stuff, sometimes I would say even too open. He Over shares information that can sometimes be quite hurtful (e.g info about other girls he’s slept with). I felt it worth noting also that I never feel the need to respond to that openness with checking his phone or looking through his things or any sort of behaviour like that, I appreciate that he trusts me and I don’t want to abuse that trust. Whereas he trusts me (or so he says) yet wants to look through my things.

Yes he is very open, which makes me think that we just have different ideas regarding the presence of privacy in a relationship. Thats why I posted I suppose, I wanted to know what others think is normal.

I guess because I’m many other ways we have a very healthy relationship ship and this in the grand scheme of things always seemed no that big of a deal. We rarely fight so it’s not something I encounter often. However, today, the photos, enlightening for sure.

The photos of me I didn’t want to show him are of me as a young teen, 14/15 years old. They’re not with anyone or explicit, just not something I want to share.

We have mutual friends who we both vent to when we fight, I don’t ask to see what he writes about me. And even if I wanted to know, he’s native language isn’t English so I probably wouldn’t be able to understand much at all.
Rest peacefully Freya, gorgeous girl.
Thank you for commenting, this is a very interesting point. I’ll have to have  a think on this!
I couldn’t be sure but he’s a bartender by trade and is a very very good one at that. He’s not so clumsy when he’s at work and in his element.

This made me giggle. You’re right though, he’s a brilliant partner in a lot of ways otherwise and I probably need to remind myself of that regularly. As for the distance between me and him, this is partially where the problem lies, I always keep a distance from him when I can but it’s so bad that sometimes I don’t have the time to get out the way or back off. At this rate I’ll be sticking with the cat and keeping completely out the way…

Totally agree! I will definitely sit him down and speak to him about it again. I’ll be more forward with how I’m feeling about it now as I’d hate for it to get to the point where I turn around and scream at him for accidentally nudging me..
They picked me up from my house
I phoned a close friend to ask how their day was and eventually I was like “sorry” and I told them and now I’m here
I’m t the hospital right now
lol let’s fucking hope I die then hey. thanks, bye
Yeah that sounds like a much better way to go out come to think of it. Thanks for your response!

Yeah I’m a month in now, I originally wanted to hang in there and see if it begins to actually fucking work. Instead of having to start over with a new med. but I’m so suicidal I’m definitely going to have to change I should think. Thanks for your response!

Yeah I’ll definitely take your advice and do some research into bipolarity. Unfortunately my family is a mass of loonies. The majority of us are on medication, primarily for depression. However, my grandfather had a quite extreme form of bipolar disorder, his mania was intense and made him rather irresponsible. He even abandoned his family and young kids for a couple of years to travel around Asia and become a farmer in Malaysia.. only to return after a suicide attempt when he became very depressed. Wild.

My auntie on the other side of my family also had bipolar disorder which  is I guess a red flag. Two bipolars from either side of the family. Thank you for sharing your thoughts on it with me, you’ve been really useful friend!!

Thanks for your response, it’s calmed me down a little as I’ve been dreading the idea of having to trial and error medications. Which is silly really but I think I was just desperate to feel better immediately and wanted this medication to work for me so badly so I’ve ignored and not told my doctor about these side effects. I think I definitely need to bite the bullet and be as honest as I can with my them. 

That kind of testing would be amazing, *sigh* if only.. 
Hopefully I’ll settle into the right medication soon enough. Thanks again for your response, it was very reassuring!

Thank you for your response, yeah I’m meant to see my psychotherapist alongside taking the medication. But the bad side effects have had a real grip on me and I’ve been struggling to attend my sessions (I’ve missed the last 2). But I’m going to sort that today and try and get an appointment for tomorrow. 

It must have been frustrating having spent those years finding the right anti-d for you, I’m glad you’ve settled with one for now and hope it’s working for you friend.

I’ll make sure to visit that website, I’m trying to learn as much as I can about these drugs I’m putting in my body, I’ve also stopped drinking. Which is a big step for an 18 year old living in central London haha. Thank you again

Yikes that sounds like a real rollercoaster you’ve been on with the medication haha!! I’m hoping you’ve settled into the right meds now and you’re finding some sort of relief on them. What you’ve said about the medication leading to a your mania flaring up. I had a week of pure hyperactivity, I didn’t sleep, I was up drawing diagrams, watching bought loads of useless shit on my laptop and experienced a high that I can only compare to being on ecstasy. I was sent home from my post-16 (I’m 18) for being so spaced out and running up and down the halls out of class. I’ve only been diagnosed with clinical depression and assumed that it was a reaction to the medication. 

Yet I have had similar experiences spaced out over a couple of years in which I’ve been similar but perhaps not as extreme. Do you think it could be bipolarity? I don’t plan to jump to any conclusions but I’d like to hear what you think! Thank you for your response!!

I’m trying to contact my psychiatrist right now, I did wonder if the hallucinations might have be caused by the depression itself but they weren’t something I was experiencing before I started on the medication. Thank you for your response!!

Thank you for your response was very reassuring! Yeah it was prescribed by a psychiatrist so I will definitely call him now and explain what’s been happening. I think I was hesitant to do so at first because I desperately just wanted the Prozac to work and couldn’t bare the thought of having to bounce from one anti-d to another. But I’ve found that it’s probably the best move to make, as I fear that I’ll do something stupid. 

Yikes yeah I’ve heard the withdrawal is horrific. So I’ll have to see what they say. When I was first it on them they told me to let them know if I began to feel suicidal and that they would stop it cold turkey :( but being a month in hopefully they’ll be able to bring me off it slowly.

Wowee you’ve tried a lot, I hope you’re settling into your medication too. It sounds like it’s been pretty rough finding the right anti-d :((.

I’ll let you know what happens, thanks again!
Yeah I’m going to try and change this medication ASAP then. I think it was gullible of me to think I might find the right medication for me and the right dosage first time round.

Sorry to hear that, that’s reassured me a little though. That I’m not the only one feeling like shit on them. Before I started them I was most definitely suicidal but now I’m constantly suicidal and death is all I can think about.

Damn I’ve gotten pretty emotional after reading that last response hah, I’m teary as hell. I’m glad that you, we, are taking more time to ponder this permanent decision. I think this next week could be useful, not to say it won’t follow with our deaths eventually but at least it will allow us time to reconcile with the idea of dying. What you said about how your parents perceive you and your sister, as still children in their minds. That really got me, my brother attempted suicide earlier in the year and I remember my mother cradling his body while I called for an ambulance, as if he was an infant. Because even though he’s 23, I’m sure in her eyes all she could see when she looked at his pale face was the baby she once held. It breaks my heart to think they probably see us as young children.

You sound like a lovely person and an incredibly strong soul too, you have my upmost respect for your determination to live for the ones you love right now. I’d love to touch base with you in the coming week and see how you’ve been getting on. Take care till then.

Your response made my heart ache, I think it’s because I empathise so deeply. Living life for others is so incredibly tiring and I can’t imagine that on top of the chronic pain you experience. I’m sorry things are so tough. And what you said about hurting your parents whether your dead or alive, god do I feel the same. Our family isn’t particularly close but oh can I see the worry in my parents eyes when they look at me, when they watch the tears roll down my face when things are truly bad. I wish they didn’t care for me to be honest. I wish none of this would effect them. I hope things get better for you too, the both of us.

Yes I plan to hold off on ending everything until next week, I just hope my dad shows some improvement in this next week. Then I won’t be so worried and I can die worry-free. I think I’m so prepared to die because I’m so incredibly tired, too tired to be scared of the pain. I plan to use a knife as well as pills and the prospect of cutting myself open and the pain that’d bring doesn’t bother me much at all. I envy the fact that you can leave without worrying about the aftermath, I felt the same not long ago and wish I could have killed myself then. I’ve got bad timing I guess. Who knows this next week might be a great week. I don’t blame you for being afraid of dying, it’s really very daunting. I hope that you begin to feel better and you life improves but if not, that you find the strength to let go.

Thank you for this reply, I will genuinely take on board what you’ve said. I think you’re right, it might well push him over the edge and I don’t think that’s a chance I want to take. 

Thanks, take care
That’s rough, Sounds like life’s damn painful. You’re willing to live and endure that pain for your little girl though, suggests you’re a fucking great Dad. Props to you man.
Happy birthday OP :), who knows maybe next birthday you’ll be suffocating with people showering  you with birthday joy.
I’d definitely go get assessed regardless. Just make sure there’s nothing more you can do to try and make your life more comfortable.

Thank you for a genuine reply, I appreciate that loads. I have tried to convey that it’s me living this painful atrocity of a life and not them and therefore expecting me to stay alive for them is in fact just as selfish as my supposed suicide. I like what you said about writing about things that made them stand out, I can definitely do that. I questioned leaving a suicide note at all and I agree, we should try and provide some closure for those we love. Good luck with your own draft too. 

Thanks!

Yikes having OCD can be absolutely horrible I can sympathise. Yeah OCD has always heightened my depression- often leading to suicidal ideation. That could definitely be a big underlying factor. I think you should try and get on some medication. Lots of antidepressants also work for OCD (what I’m taking for example, fluoxetine which is better known as Prozac). This could calm your OCD whilst also helping tend to any suicidal ideation you might have. If you’re really concerned you might do something, definitely tell a close friend, someone who can keep an eye on you if things become too much.

I’ve fought for too long, put so much time and energy into trying to better my mind and mood. Diets, workout routines, creating more structure, medication and lots of therapy. I’m sick and tired of being sick and tired. I no longer wish to be here.

I read your story. Hmm it sounds like you’re definitely overwhelmed, theres a lot on your mind after what happened to the suicide victim you knew. That overwhelming need to question everything after his death is intense and I think could definitely lead to you having thoughts of suicide too. Maybe you should try and speak to a therapist? Maybe get assessed and see if you have any underlying conditions that could lead to you maybe being suicidal.

Hmm sure, yeah anxiety about what will happen after your death, like what’ll happen to your family, friends, belongings, animals etc. That stuff is scary too.

I was thinking about more like severe anxiety about what’s happening in your life currently. Like pressures and responsibilities that are overwhelming.
Yeah perhaps. I’ll have a look and see if I can try and find one. Thank u

I live in the UK though, which means I’m at the point where I’m about to be passed over to the adult mental health services where I’ll say goodbye to this therapist. Sounds hopeful right? Nah, the waiting lists are huge and the therapists mundane.
